title: Yellow Garlic American Tofu Stir Fry
description: A garlicky and savory American dish featuring seasoned rice vinegar and stir-fry, perfect for a date night, and shojin-friendly for a vegetarian diet. This recipe combines the flavors of garlic, ginger, and soy sauce with the crunch of bell peppers and the softness of tofu.

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the sliced bell peppers and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add the cubed tofu and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the seasoned rice vinegar and soy sauce.
Pour the vinegar-soy sauce mixture over the tofu and bell peppers and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
